mapper.select: SELECT a.ALERT_SEQ AS alertSeq, TO_CHAR(a.ALERT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS alertDate, a.ALERT_TYPE AS alertType, a.ALERT_LEVEL AS alertLevel, a.ALERT_CMD AS alertCmd, a.REGION_NM AS regionNm, a.REGION_CD AS regionCd, a.PARENT_REGION AS parentRegion, a.ISSUE_DT AS issueDt, a.EFFECT_DT AS effectDt, a.CANCEL_NOTE AS cancelNote FROM TB_WEATHER_ALERT a WHERE TRUNC(a.ALERT_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) ORDER BY a.ALERT_TYPE, a.ALERT_LEVEL, a.REGION_NM

SELECT w.RISK_SEQ AS riskSeq, TO_CHAR(w.RISK_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS riskDate, w.REGION_CD AS regionCd, w.REGION_NM AS regionNm, w.DISTRICT_NM AS districtNm, w.WEATHER_SCORE AS weatherScore, w.WILDFIRE_SCORE AS wildfireScore, w.WILDFIRE_GRADE AS wildfireGrade, w.WILDFIRE_TM AS wildfireTm, w.APPLIED_ALERTS AS appliedAlerts FROM TB_WEATHER_RISK w WHERE TRUNC(w.RISK_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
AND (NVL(w.WEATHER_SCORE, 0) > 0 OR NVL(w.WILDFIRE_SCORE, 0) > 0)
AND w.REGION_NM = #{regionNm}
AND w.DISTRICT_NM = #{districtNm}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_BLDG_RISK_STATIC b WHERE REPLACE(COALESCE(TRIM(b.REGION_NM), ''), ' ', '') = REPLACE(COALESCE(TRIM(w.REGION_NM), ''), ' ', '') AND REPLACE(COALESCE(TRIM(b.DISTRICT_NM), ''), ' ', '') = REPLACE(COALESCE(TRIM(w.DISTRICT_NM), ''), ' ', '') AND REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(b.BRANCH_NM, '')), ' ', '') = REPLACE(TRIM(#{branchNm}), ' ', '') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_BLDG_RISK_STATIC b LEFT JOIN TB_BRANCH_HQ_MAP m ON REPLACE(TRIM(m.BRANCH_NM), ' ', '') = REPLACE(TRIM(b.BRANCH_NM), ' ', '') AND m.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE REPLACE(COALESCE(TRIM(b.REGION_NM), ''), ' ', '') = REPLACE(COALESCE(TRIM(w.REGION_NM), ''), ' ', '') AND REPLACE(COALESCE(TRIM(b.DISTRICT_NM), ''), ' ', '') = REPLACE(COALESCE(TRIM(w.DISTRICT_NM), ''), ' ', '') AND COALESCE(m.HQ_NM, b.REGION_NM) = #{hqNm} )
ORDER BY NVL(w.WILDFIRE_SCORE, 0) DESC, NVL(w.WEATHER_SCORE, 0) DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(w.RISK_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS riskDate, COUNT(*) AS regionCnt, ROUND(AVG(w.WEATHER_SCORE), 2) AS avgWeatherScore, MAX(w.WEATHER_SCORE) AS maxWeatherScore, SUM(CASE WHEN w.WEATHER_SCORE > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scoreRegionCnt FROM TB_WEATHER_RISK w
AND w.RISK_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD')
AND w.RISK_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD')
GROUP BY w.RISK_DATE ORDER BY w.RISK_DATE DESC
SELECT TRIM(HQ_NM) AS "hqNm", TRIM(BRANCH_NM) AS "branchNm" FROM TB_BRANCH_HQ_MAP WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND HQ_NM IS NOT NULL AND BRANCH_NM IS NOT NULL ORDER BY HQ_NM, BRANCH_NM
